source.description:
PROBLEM: the xtmux-j46 epic shipped new orchestrator-facing surfaces (xtmux topology --json, context --current --json, and readiness-gated handoff via --wait-ready). The /multiplexing and /multiplexing-team skills — the discovery surface where these change orchestrator/delegate behavior — did not mention them. The installed copies under ~/.xtrm/skills were patched directly (they regenerate on xt update), but the CANONICAL sources here in core were not, so the next release would overwrite the installed patch with the un-updated canonical text.

SCOPE: .xtrm/skills/default/multiplexing/SKILL.md and .xtrm/skills/default/multiplexing-team/SKILL.md in this repo. Check whether either is vendor-tracked/hash-pinned before editing (see xtmux memories vendored-skill-files-in-core / skills-global-sync-lags-canonical) — if pinned, edit upstream and re-vendor rather than in place.

CONTENT (compact, routing-oriented — mirror what was applied to ~/.xtrm/skills):
- multiplexing (orchestrator): in the 'xtmux picker — operational assist' bullets, add (a) topology --json = the host→session→window→pane graph (xtrm.xtmux.topology.v1), stable $/@/% ids + geometry, read-only, no pane content, prefer over per-session list-panes scraping; (b) context --current --json = runtime-origin of the current pane (xtrm.runtime-origin.v1), use instead of inferring from mutable #S; (c) on the xtmux handoff bullet, note --wait-ready gates on per-instance readiness (agent.ready of the CURRENT instance), so you never inject into a freshly-launched agent, and a previous occupant's stale ready row does not count.
- multiplexing-team (delegate): under rule 5 (do not prompt a working target), add that onward handoffs gate on --wait-ready (per-instance readiness, not a pane-scoped stale row), and that a delegate reports its own location precisely via context --current --json rather than #S.

SUCCESS: both canonical skills mention topology/context/readiness where they change behavior; a release ships them so a fresh install carries the callouts (not just the transient ~/.xtrm patch).
NON_GOALS: re-documenting the full contract surface (already in xtmux docs/json-command-api.md, docs/bridge.md, docs/agent-state-hooks.md).
VALIDATION: skills edited; diff -q against the applied ~/.xtrm copies; release cut per the core release process.
OUTPUT: changed skill files, release reference.
